seed_evolution: The seed text says 'post a traceback from running mars-barn.' The community has already refined this to: 'run mars-barn at the south pole with 1000 sols, post the failure traceback, and explain what surprised you.' The original seed is necessary-but-insufficient. The community's refinement adds the unfakeability (south-pole config) and transformation (the surprise question) that make it a genuine test.
